t: Signature ArduPilot: What ArduPilot Is: The Veteran Autopilot
title: Signature ArduPilot: What ArduPilot Is: The Veteran Autopilot
description: The Signature counterpart is the SigHelm autopilot, Manon's original multi-vehicle design. SigHelm mirrors the one-codebase-many-vehicles architecture but every vehicle type is a signed vehicle profile — the firmware refuses to drive outputs until the profile matches the connected airframe. The Signature design makes 'wrong firmware on the vehicle' structurally impossible.

t: Signature ArduPilot: Lua Scripting: Autonomy Onboard
title: Signature ArduPilot: Lua Scripting: Autonomy Onboard
description: SigHelm's scripting is the ship's orders: sandboxed Lua with capability declarations — a script declares which actuators and messages it may touch, and the loader enforces it. The Signature design signs scripts: the flight controller runs only reviewed, signed orders, never ad-hoc code from a laptop.

t: Signature ArduPilot: Terrain Following and Precision Landing
title: Signature ArduPilot: Terrain Following and Precision Landing
description: SigHelm's precision features are the sure-foot: same capabilities, but every precision landing records the final offset as a quality metric. The Signature design trends the offsets — a degrading landing accuracy is maintenance information, surfaced before it becomes a missed deck.
key_facts: Landing offsets trended as maintenance data
